headlines.title: 2.1万亿隔夜逆回购护航跨月 央行“给量不给价”释放清晰信号
headlines.summary: 【2.1万亿隔夜逆回购护航跨月 央行“给量不给价”释放清晰信号】中国人民银行日前公告，为更好匹配银行体系短期流动性需求，央行将采用固定利率、数量招标模式，于7月29日至31日每日开展6000亿元隔夜逆回购操作，8月3日追加开展3000亿元操作，累计投放规模达21000亿元。此次隔夜逆回购操作，无论是投放规模还是操作频次，均较6月末首次操作显著升级。同时，操作延续“给量不给价”，仅公布投放数量、未披露中标利率，清晰凸显隔夜逆回购的工具定位：主要用于短期流动性精准调节，而非价格调控作用。

headlines.summary_en: [2.1 Trillion Overnight Reverse Repos Guard Cross-Month, PBOC 'Gives Quantity Not Price' Sends Clear Signal] The People's Bank of China announced it will conduct 600 billion yuan overnight reverse repo operations each day from July 29 to 31, with an additional 300 billion yuan on August 3, totaling 2.1 trillion yuan, using fixed rates and quantity-based bidding to better match short-term liquidity needs. Both the scale and frequency of operations are significantly upgraded from the first use at end-June. The operations continue 'giving quantity not price', only disclosing the amount without the winning rate, highlighting the tool's role: precise short-term liquidity adjustment, not price control.

headlines.title: 新策略实现超高稳定性钠离子电池
headlines.summary: 在国家自然科学基金等项目资助下，广东工业大学材料与能源学院副教授张伟、教授熊世云和教授黄少铭团队在钠离子电池负极材料领域取得重要进展。相关成果近日发表于《先进材料》（Advanced Materials）。该研究首次从路易斯酸碱催化角度揭示了多硒化物转化与穿梭的内在机制，提出了“电子结构调控-双位点自催化-晶格缓冲”协同设计新范式，为开发超长寿命金属硒化物负极材料提供了全新思路，对推动钠离子电池在大规模储能领域的实际应用具有重要意义。（中国科学报）

headlines.summary_en: Funded by the National Natural Science Foundation, a team from Guangdong University of Technology led by Associate Professor Wei Zhang, Professor Shiyun Xiong, and Professor Shaoming Huang made significant progress in sodium-ion battery anode materials. Published recently in Advanced Materials, the study reveals the intrinsic mechanism of polyselenide conversion and shuttle from a Lewis acid-base catalysis perspective, proposing a new 'electronic structure regulation - dual-site self-catalysis - lattice buffer' synergistic design paradigm, offering new ideas for developing ultra-long-life metal selenide anodes, with implications for large-scale energy storage applications. (China Science Daily)

According to incomplete statistics, as of the evening of July 24, over ten companies have disclosed plans for share buybacks or major shareholder stake increases since July. headlines.title: 上证报：8月市场有望轮动修复，行情重心加速向业绩验证集中
headlines.summary: 上周，A股市场震荡修复，主要指数周线悉数收涨。市场结构性分化特征突出，资金高低切换、风格均衡化的交易信号显现。券商策略展望报告认为，近期监管部门与央国企密集释放增持、回购等稳市信号，叠加流动性压力缓解，市场已具备筑底基础。展望后市，行情重心正加速向半年度业绩验证转移，建议投资者均衡配置，同时在科技成长内部分化中寻觅结构性机会。

headlines.summary_en: Last week, the A-share market recovered with volatility, with all major indexes closing higher. Structural differentiation was pronounced, with signs of capital rotation from high to low and style equalization. Broker strategy outlook reports suggest recent regulators and state-owned enterprises have intensively released market-stabilizing signals like stake increases and buybacks, and with easing liquidity pressure, the market has a foundation for bottoming. Looking ahead, the market's focus is accelerating toward semi-annual performance verification, recommending balanced allocation and seeking structural opportunities within tech growth divergence.

headlines.summary: 【住户存款少增3.19万亿元背后：从表内定存到资管市场 一场静水流深的居民财富再配置】李啸（化名）曾是坚定的“存款派”，把多年积蓄“锁”在银行等待买房时机。可这两年，1年期定存利率已降至1%左右，他的想法随之转变：短期继续租房，把存款“搬”出来重新规划。这或许是近年来众多家庭资产配置变化的一个缩影。日前，央行公布的数据显示：2026年上半年，住户存款增加7.58万亿元，同比少增3.19万亿元；非银行业金融机构（券商、基金、保险、理财子公司等）存款增加4.65万亿元，同比多增2.1万亿元。

headlines.summary_en: [Resident Deposits Increase 3.19 Trillion Less: From On-Book Time Deposits to Asset Management Markets — A Silent Shift in Household Wealth Reallocation] Li Xiao (pseudonym), once a staunch 'deposit advocate', locked years of savings in the bank waiting to buy a home. But with 1-year time deposit rates dropping to around 1% in recent years, his thinking shifted: renting short-term and moving deposits for re-planning. This may reflect a microcosm of changing household asset allocation in recent years. PBOC data shows: in H1 2026, resident deposits increased by 7.58 trillion yuan, 3.19 trillion less year-on-year; deposits of non-bank financial institutions (securities, funds, insurance, wealth management subsidiaries) increased by 4.65 trillion yuan, 2.1 trillion more year-on-year.

headlines.title: 7月新股密集上市，北交所高质量扩容提速
headlines.summary: 7月24日，随着长鹰硬科正式登陆北交所，北交所上市公司总数扩容至330家。至此，2026年以来北交所已迎来43只新股上市——上半年完成36单IPO，7月以来再添7只新股。值得一提的是，无论是发行数量还是募资规模，均已超过2025年全年，北交所正以肉眼可见的速度迈入高质量扩容新阶段。（中证报）

headlines.summary_en: On July 24, with Changying Hard Alloy officially listing on the BSE, the total number of BSE-listed companies expanded to 330. Since 2026, the BSE has welcomed 43 new stock listings: 36 IPOs completed in H1 and 7 more since July. Notably, both the number and fundraising scale have already exceeded the full year of 2025, with the BSE entering a high-quality expansion phase at a visible pace. (China Securities Journal)
